items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: Although, the Dodds that played with King Oliver is a fine style, which I probably do try to play a bit like

ctx.x: I wondered about who some of your favorite musicians were, just in general, any instrument or any approach to jazz. Not necessarily jazz, that's what you like.

Well, it's jazz. I listen to jazz, I suppose, only. It just doesn't seem to be time to listen to jazz enough, much less to other things. I can't, I'm not, not sort of, madly interested in solo work as such, so that I listen more for ensemble and try and play that in the band. And, undoubtedly, Lewis must feature strongly in it. Although I see quite a lot of fault in his playing and all this sort of thing. He's got the great sort of commanding glory that he plays hot. That's the thing that counts. Dodds, I still…
It's hard to pick out one. I think we're just about running out of.
